issues.explanation: The feature ships with no Pest tests even though the project requires test-first development and has many explicit edge cases to cover (validation rules, daily restart, malformed/legacy codes, factory dates, UpdateQueue errors).

The conventions say there is no production code without a test and the suite must pass before a change is done. With no tests here, and existing 'A001'-based tests not visibly updated, there is no evidence that either holds.

The old unique (queue_id, code) is dropped before the new (queue_id, code, issue_date) is created. On MariaDB/MySQL this can fail if that index backs the queue_id foreign key; creating the new index first would avoid it.

Map normalization and validation are duplicated between the action and the model saving hook. The action could rely on the hook, which it already wraps with an InvalidArgumentException catch at UpdateQueue.php:84.
DEFAULT_PREFIX_MAP is declared but never used: defaultPrefixFor and validatePrefixMap hard-code the letters and the [0, 10, 20] levels, so the two can drift apart.
Any InvalidArgumentException raised while saving, whatever its source, is reported as a priority_prefix_map validation error, which can hide unrelated failures.
The catch (\Throwable) around date parsing and the is_numeric($queueId) guard are speculative defensive code that silently hides bad factory input.
The string-key lookup is redundant because PHP arrays (and JSON-decoded maps) store canonical numeric keys as ints.

review.summary: The change implements priority-based prefixes (N/P/E with a validated per-queue override), per-prefix daily sequences backed by a new issue_date column and unique index, single-clock issuance, factory alignment, UpdateQueue map management and the required doc updates. The implementation is mostly correct and well scoped. However, it ships no tests at all, which violates the project's mandatory TDD convention and leaves the many specified edge cases unverified, and it has some duplicated normalization/validation logic. The change needs a full test suite before it can be approved.
